examples.translation_zh: 许多公司决定公开上市他们的股票。

examples.sentence: The startup went public last year and gained attention.
examples.translation_zh: 这家初创公司去年上市，引起了关注。

examples.sentence: They plan to go public soon to raise funds.
examples.translation_zh: 他们计划很快公开上市以筹集资金。

go by.def_en: To travel past something while going somewhere.

examples.sentence: I usually go by bus to work every day.
examples.translation_zh: 我通常每天乘公共汽车上班。

examples.sentence: Many tourists go by train to explore the city.
examples.translation_zh: 许多游客乘火车游览这座城市。

examples.sentence: Time seems to go by fast during the summer.
examples.translation_zh: 夏天时，时间似乎过得很快。

go on an outing.def_en: To take a trip or excursion for enjoyment.

examples.collocation: go on an outing with friends
examples.sentence: We often go on an outing with friends during the weekends.
examples.translation_zh: 我们经常在周末和朋友外出游玩。

examples.collocation: go on an outing to the park
examples.sentence: They will go on an outing to the park tomorrow.
examples.translation_zh: 他们明天将去公园外出游玩。

examples.collocation: go on an outing for education
examples.sentence: Students can go on an outing for education and fun.
examples.translation_zh: 学生可以外出游玩，既学习又娱乐。

go to bed.def_en: To lie down and sleep or rest in bed.

examples.sentence: Children often go to bed late during the summer.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们在夏天常常很晚上床睡觉。

examples.collocation: decided to go to bed early
examples.sentence: After feeling tired, I decided to go to bed early.
examples.translation_zh: 感到疲倦后，我决定早点上床睡觉。

examples.sentence: Many workers forget to go to bed after a long day.
examples.translation_zh: 许多工人在长时间工作后忘记上床睡觉。

go a long way.def_zh: 有很大帮助；起到重要作用
go a long way.def_en: To be very useful or beneficial in achieving something.

examples.collocation: go a long way in improving performance
examples.sentence: These strategies can go a long way in improving performance.
examples.translation_zh: 这些策略能够在提高绩效方面起到很大帮助。

examples.collocation: go a long way to help others
examples.sentence: Your support can go a long way to help others.
examples.translation_zh: 你的支持能够在帮助他人方面起到重要作用。

examples.collocation: go a long way towards success
examples.sentence: Studying hard will go a long way towards success.
examples.translation_zh: 努力学习能够在取得成功方面起到很大帮助。

go wrong.def_en: To experience a mistake or problem in a situation.

examples.sentence: Often, things go wrong with the plan we made.
examples.translation_zh: 计划中经常会出错。

examples.sentence: Sometimes, answers go wrong during the test.
examples.translation_zh: 有时候，测试中的答案会出错。

examples.sentence: They worried that things might go wrong on their trip.
examples.translation_zh: 他们担心旅行中可能会出问题。

good at.def_en: To have skill or ability in a particular area.

examples.sentence: Students who are good at math often excel in school.
examples.translation_zh: 擅长数学的学生通常在学校表现出色。

examples.sentence: My sister is good at cooking delicious meals.
examples.translation_zh: 我姐姐擅长做美味的饭菜。

examples.sentence: Effective leaders are good at teamwork and collaboration.
examples.translation_zh: 有效的领导者擅长团队合作与协作。

go shopping.def_en: To visit shops to buy goods or services.

examples.sentence: They often go shopping with friends on weekends.
examples.translation_zh: 他们周末经常和朋友一起去购物。

examples.sentence: She loves to go shopping for clothes during sales.
examples.translation_zh: 她喜欢在打折时去购物买衣服。

examples.sentence: We decided to go shopping at the mall this afternoon.
examples.translation_zh: 我们决定今天下午去商场购物。

good with.def_en: To be skilled at dealing with people or situations.

examples.sentence: She is really good with children and enjoys playing.
examples.translation_zh: 她非常善于与孩子交往，并且喜欢玩耍。

examples.sentence: He is good with numbers and helps at the office.
examples.translation_zh: 他善于处理数字，并在办公室提供帮助。

examples.sentence: Many students are good with technology and use it effectively.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生善于使用技术，并且有效利用它。

graffiti.def_en: Writing or drawings made on public surfaces without permission.

examples.sentence: Street graffiti often reflects the perspectives of local communities.
examples.translation_zh: 街头涂鸦通常反映了当地社区的观点。

examples.sentence: Political graffiti can convey strong messages about social issues.
examples.translation_zh: 政治涂鸦可以传达关于社会问题的强烈信息。

examples.sentence: Many cities now recognize graffiti art as a legitimate form of expression.
examples.translation_zh: 许多城市现在将涂鸦艺术视为一种合法的表达形式。

grassland.def_en: An area covered chiefly with grass and low plants.

examples.sentence: Tropical grasslands support a variety of wildlife species.
examples.translation_zh: 热带草原支持多种野生动物物种。

examples.sentence: Temperate grasslands are important for agriculture and livestock.
examples.translation_zh: 温带草原对农业和畜牧业非常重要。

examples.sentence: Grassland ecosystems play a vital role in maintaining biodiversity.
examples.translation_zh: 草原生态系统在维护生物多样性中起着重要作用。

go with.def_en: To accompany or match something or someone.

examples.sentence: I like to go with a friend to the movies.
examples.translation_zh: 我喜欢和朋友一起去看电影。

examples.sentence: These shoes go with the dress very well.
examples.translation_zh: 这些鞋子和这件裙子非常搭配。

examples.sentence: You should go with your plan for the project.
examples.translation_zh: 你应该按照你的计划进行这个项目。

great-aunt.def_zh: 姑姑的姐妹；姨妈的姐妹
great-aunt.def_en: The sister of one's uncle or aunt.

examples.sentence: My great-aunt often tells fascinating family stories.
examples.translation_zh: 我的姑姑常常讲有趣的家族故事。

examples.sentence: We visited my great-aunt's house during the family reunion.
examples.translation_zh: 我们在家庭团聚期间拜访了我的姑姑家。

examples.sentence: Students often learn about great-aunts and uncles in family tree projects.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们在家谱项目中常常了解姑姑和叔叔。

gunfire.def_en: The sound of firearms being discharged continuously.

examples.sentence: Gunfire erupted in the city center during the protest yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 昨天，抗议活动中市中心发生了枪声。

examples.sentence: Soldiers moved cautiously under heavy gunfire in the war zone.
examples.translation_zh: 士兵们在战区内小心翼翼地穿行，周围是密集的枪声。

examples.sentence: The report analyzed the exchange of gunfire during the military engagement.
examples.translation_zh: 该报告分析了军事交战中的枪声交火。

greenhouse gases.def_en: Gases that trap heat in the atmosphere, contributing to global warming.

examples.sentence: We need to reduce greenhouse gases to protect our planet.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要减少温室气体以保护我们的星球。

examples.sentence: Many industries emit greenhouse gases during production processes.
examples.translation_zh: 许多行业在生产过程中排放温室气体。

examples.sentence: Scientists measure greenhouse gases to study climate change effects.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家测量温室气体以研究气候变化影响。

hand out.def_en: To give something to multiple people or distribute it.

examples.sentence: Volunteers will hand out flyers in the park tomorrow.
examples.translation_zh: 志愿者明天将在公园分发传单。

examples.sentence: The committee will hand out awards at the ceremony tonight.
examples.translation_zh: 委员会将在今晚的颁奖典礼上分发奖项。

examples.sentence: Teachers often hand out supplies at the beginning of the school year.
examples.translation_zh: 老师们通常在学年开始时分发用品。

haiku.def_en: A form of Japanese poetry consisting of three lines.

examples.sentence: Many students enjoy writing haiku poetry during their creative writing classes.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生喜欢在创意写作课上写俳句。

examples.sentence: The teacher assigned a haiku collection for the students to analyze together.
examples.translation_zh: 老师布置了一本俳句合集，供学生们一起分析。

examples.sentence: I often read a haiku series in the morning to inspire my day.
examples.translation_zh: 我常在早上阅读一系列俳句，以激励自己的一天。

handshake.def_en: A greeting involving grasping another person's hand.

examples.sentence: People often greet each other with a firm handshake during meetings.
examples.translation_zh: 人们在会议中常常用一个稳固的握手来问候彼此。

examples.sentence: A business handshake can signify the start of a new partnership.
examples.translation_zh: 商业握手可以象征着新伙伴关系的开始。

examples.sentence: During online conferences, participants can make a virtual handshake to connect.
examples.translation_zh: 在在线会议中，参与者可以进行虚拟握手以建立联系。

hang up.def_en: To end a phone call or conversation.

examples.sentence: Please hang up the phone when you are done.
examples.translation_zh: 请在结束时挂断电话。

examples.sentence: She hung up on him during the argument.
examples.translation_zh: 她在争吵时挂断了他的电话。

examples.sentence: Students should hang up the call after the lesson.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们应该在课程结束后挂断电话。

hardly ever.def_en: To rarely do something; almost never.

examples.sentence: She hardly ever goes out on weekends.
examples.translation_zh: 她周末几乎从不外出。

examples.sentence: I hardly ever see him in the office.
examples.translation_zh: 我在办公室几乎从不见到他。

examples.sentence: Such events hardly ever happen in this field.
examples.translation_zh: 在这个领域，这种事件几乎从不发生。

have to.def_en: To be required to do something; obligation or necessity.

examples.sentence: Students have to study for their exams every day.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们每天都必须为考试学习。

examples.sentence: I have to go to the store after work.
examples.translation_zh: 我下班后必须去商店。

examples.sentence: We have to finish this project by Friday.
examples.translation_zh: 我们必须在星期五之前完成这个项目。

have second thoughts.def_en: To reconsider a decision or opinion previously held.

examples.collocation: have second thoughts about the job offer
examples.sentence: She began to have second thoughts about the job offer she received.
examples.translation_zh: 她开始对收到的工作邀请产生了改变主意。

examples.collocation: have second thoughts on the project
examples.sentence: After some feedback, the team had second thoughts on the project direction.
examples.translation_zh: 在收到反馈后，团队对项目方向产生了改变主意。

examples.collocation: have second thoughts regarding the trip
examples.sentence: He started to have second thoughts regarding the trip planned for next month.
examples.translation_zh: 他开始对下个月计划的旅行产生了改变主意。

happening.def_en: An event or occurrence, especially one that is notable.

examples.sentence: What's happening in your neighborhood this weekend?
examples.translation_zh: 这个周末你所在的社区发生了什么？

examples.sentence: Many people are curious about what is happening now in the world.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人对世界上正在发生的事情感到好奇。

examples.sentence: There are numerous festivals happening at the moment across the city.
examples.translation_zh: 当前城市里正在举行许多节日庆典。

have a point.def_en: To have a valid argument or reason for something.

examples.collocation: have a point in this discussion
examples.sentence: Your argument seems strong; you really have a point in this discussion.
examples.translation_zh: 你的论点似乎很有力，您在这个讨论中确实有道理。

examples.sentence: I think you have a point about that issue at work.
examples.translation_zh: 我认为您在那个工作问题上确实有道理。

examples.sentence: People may not agree, but you have a point sometimes.
examples.translation_zh: 人们可能不同意，但有时候您说的确实有道理。

hang out.def_en: To spend time relaxing or socializing with friends.

examples.sentence: We usually hang out with friends on weekends.
examples.translation_zh: 我们通常在周末和朋友闲逛。

examples.sentence: They love to hang out at the mall after school.
examples.translation_zh: 他们下课后喜欢在商场闲逛。

examples.sentence: Students often hang out together in the library.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们常常在图书馆一起闲逛。

have fun.def_en: To enjoy oneself; to engage in enjoyable activities.

examples.sentence: Everyone should have fun at the party tonight.
examples.translation_zh: 每个人今晚都应该在派对上玩得开心。

examples.sentence: We will have fun with friends during the weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 我们周末会和朋友们一起玩得开心。

examples.sentence: Students can have fun while learning new things.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们在学习新知识时可以玩得开心。

have to do with.def_en: To relate to or be connected with something.

examples.sentence: Many students believe school has to do with their future.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生相信，学校与他们的未来有关。

examples.sentence: This experiment has to do with the study of chemicals.
examples.translation_zh: 这项实验与化学研究有关。

examples.sentence: They say art has to do with culture and history.
examples.translation_zh: 他们说，艺术与文化和历史有关。

healthily.def_en: In a way that promotes good health.

examples.sentence: Many people try to eat healthily every day.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人每天都努力健康饮食。

examples.sentence: To live healthily, one should exercise regularly.
examples.translation_zh: 为了健康生活，应该定期锻炼。

examples.sentence: Students are encouraged to think healthily for better learning.
examples.translation_zh: 鼓励学生健康思考以提高学习效果。

headphones.def_en: Devices worn on or over the ears for audio listening.

examples.sentence: Wireless headphones allow for greater freedom of movement while listening.
examples.translation_zh: 无线耳机在听音乐时可以让你更加自由地移动。

examples.sentence: Using noise-cancelling headphones can improve concentration in busy environments.
examples.translation_zh: 使用降噪耳机可以提高在繁忙环境中的专注力。

examples.sentence: Many gamers prefer high-quality gaming headphones for an immersive experience.
examples.translation_zh: 许多玩家更喜欢高品质的游戏耳机以获得身临其境的体验。

have an impact on.def_en: To have a significant effect on something or someone.

examples.sentence: Investments in technology have an impact on education quality.
examples.translation_zh: 对教育质量产生影响的投资在科技上。

examples.sentence: Lifestyle choices can have an impact on health and well-being.
examples.translation_zh: 生活方式选择能对健康和福祉产生影响。

examples.collocation: have an impact on the environment
examples.sentence: Industrial activities have an impact on the environment and biodiversity.
examples.translation_zh: 工业活动对环境和生物多样性产生影响。

hear from.def_en: To receive communication or information from someone.

examples.sentence: Students often hear from the teacher about their grades.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们经常收到老师关于成绩的消息。

examples.sentence: I usually hear from my friend every weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 我通常每个周末收到朋友的消息。

examples.sentence: People want to hear from the news about important events.
examples.translation_zh: 人们想从新闻中收到重要事件的消息。

hear of.def_en: To have knowledge about something or someone.

examples.sentence: I often hear of a new project at meetings.
examples.translation_zh: 我经常在会议上听说一个新项目。

examples.sentence: Have you heard of it from your friends?
examples.translation_zh: 你从朋友那里听说过它吗？

examples.sentence: Many people have never heard of her achievements.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人从未听说过她的成就。

health care.def_en: The organized provision of medical services and support.

examples.sentence: Many people struggle to get access to health care in their area.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在当地难以获得医疗保健。

examples.sentence: The new policy aims to improve the health care system across the country.
examples.translation_zh: 新政策旨在改善全国的医疗保健系统。

examples.sentence: Students often discuss the need for affordable health care during their studies.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们在学习期间经常讨论对经济实惠的医疗保健的需求。

examples.sentence: She shared a heartbreaking story about her family's struggles.
examples.translation_zh: 她分享了一个令人心碎的关于她家庭挣扎的故事。

examples.sentence: It was a heartbreaking moment when she said goodbye to her dog.
examples.translation_zh: 她对狗狗说再见的那一刻令人心碎。

examples.sentence: The researchers reported heartbreaking news about the endangered species.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员报告了关于濒危物种的令人心碎的消息。

heatwave.def_en: A prolonged period of excessively hot weather.

examples.sentence: Meteorologists issued a heatwave warning for the upcoming days.
examples.translation_zh: 气象学家发布了即将到来的热浪警报。

examples.sentence: Cities experienced record heatwaves last summer, affecting many residents.
examples.translation_zh: 去年夏天，城市经历了创纪录的热浪，影响了许多居民。

examples.sentence: People often struggle to survive a heatwave without proper hydration.
examples.translation_zh: 在没有足够水分的情况下，人们往往难以度过热浪。

help out.def_en: To assist someone with a task or problem.

examples.sentence: Can you help out a friend this weekend?
examples.translation_zh: 你这个周末能帮助朋友吗？

examples.sentence: Teachers help out with homework when students ask.
examples.translation_zh: 老师在学生询问时会帮助作业。

examples.sentence: Employees help out during events to ensure everything runs smoothly.
examples.translation_zh: 员工在活动期间帮助，以确保一切顺利进行。

high school.def_en: An educational institution for students typically aged 14 to 18 years.

examples.sentence: Many teenagers are attending high school every day.
examples.translation_zh: 许多青少年每天都在上中学。

examples.sentence: High school students often join clubs after classes.
examples.translation_zh: 中学生通常在放学后加入社团。

examples.sentence: She graduated from high school last year with honors.
examples.translation_zh: 她去年以优异的成绩毕业于中学。

hidden.def_en: Concealed from view or not easily noticed.

examples.sentence: Many hidden dangers exist in our everyday environment.
examples.translation_zh: 我们日常环境中存在许多隐藏的危险。

examples.sentence: Students often have hidden talents that surprise their teachers.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们常常有让老师惊讶的隐藏才华。

examples.sentence: Exploring the city revealed many hidden treasures of history.
examples.translation_zh: 探索这座城市揭示了许多隐藏的历史宝藏。

herbal.def_en: Relating to or made from plants used for medicine or flavoring.

examples.sentence: Many people prefer herbal medicine for treating common ailments.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人更喜欢用草本药物治疗常见疾病。

examples.sentence: Drinking herbal tea can help improve your digestion and relaxation.
examples.translation_zh: 喝草本茶可以帮助改善消化和放松。

examples.sentence: Researchers are studying herbal remedies for their potential health benefits.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员正在研究草本疗法及其潜在的健康益处。

hesitation.def_en: The act of pausing before making a decision.

examples.sentence: Making a choice without hesitation in decision making is crucial for success.
examples.translation_zh: 在决策时毫不犹豫地做出选择对成功至关重要。

examples.sentence: Researchers often express hesitation when presenting uncertain findings to their peers.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员在向同行展示不确定的发现时，常常会表达犹豫。

examples.sentence: Children may show hesitation when trying new foods for the first time.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们第一次尝试新食物时可能会表现出犹豫。

hiker.def_en: A person who goes on long walks, especially in nature.

examples.sentence: Experienced hikers always prepare thoroughly before their trips.
examples.translation_zh: 经验丰富的远足者在旅行前总是做好充分准备。

examples.sentence: Don't forget to check your hiker's gear before leaving for the trail.
examples.translation_zh: 在出发去小径之前，别忘了检查远足者的装备。

examples.sentence: Hiker safety is crucial, especially in challenging weather conditions.
examples.translation_zh: 远足者的安全至关重要，尤其是在恶劣的天气条件下。

hockey.def_en: A team sport played on ice with sticks and a puck.

examples.sentence: Children love to play hockey during winter months.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们喜欢在冬天打冰球。

examples.sentence: The local hockey team won the championship last year.
examples.translation_zh: 当地的冰球队去年赢得了冠军。

examples.sentence: Fans eagerly watched the hockey game on television last night.
examples.translation_zh: 球迷们昨晚热切地观看了冰球比赛。

heartfelt.def_en: Expressing sincere feelings or emotions deeply and genuinely.

examples.sentence: Employees received heartfelt appreciation for their dedication and hard work.
examples.translation_zh: 员工们因其奉献和努力工作而获得了由衷的赞赏。

examples.sentence: The community expressed heartfelt condolences to the grieving family after the tragedy.
examples.translation_zh: 社区在悲剧发生后向伤心的家庭表示了由衷的慰问。

examples.sentence: She sent a heartfelt message to her friend, wishing her happiness and success.
examples.translation_zh: 她给朋友发了一条由衷的消息，祝愿她幸福和成功。

hold on.def_en: To remain in a position or to wait briefly.

examples.sentence: Hold on tight during the roller coaster ride.
examples.translation_zh: 在过山车上要紧紧抓住。

examples.sentence: Please hold on for a moment while I check that information.
examples.translation_zh: 请稍等片刻，我查一下那个信息。

examples.sentence: Always hold on to your dreams and work hard.
examples.translation_zh: 永远坚持自己的梦想并努力工作。

homeless.def_en: Without a home or permanent shelter.

examples.sentence: Many homeless people struggle to find basic necessities.
examples.translation_zh: 许多无家可归的人挣扎着寻找基本生活必需品。

examples.sentence: Local governments often provide homeless shelters during winter.
examples.translation_zh: 地方政府通常在冬季提供无家可归者庇护所。

examples.sentence: The homeless crisis demands immediate attention from policymakers.
examples.translation_zh: 无家可归危机迫切需要政策制定者的关注。

home economics.def_en: The study of managing a household's resources and finances.

examples.sentence: Students learn home economics to manage their finances better.
examples.translation_zh: 学生学习家庭经济学，以更好地管理他们的财务。

examples.sentence: My sister enjoys her home economics class every Friday.
examples.translation_zh: 我妹妹每周五都很喜欢她的家庭经济学课。

examples.sentence: He decided to take home economics to improve his skills.
examples.translation_zh: 他决定学习家庭经济学，以提高自己的技能。

hip-hop.def_en: A genre of music characterized by rhythmic vocal style and beats.

examples.sentence: Many young people are influenced by hip-hop culture around the world.
examples.translation_zh: 世界各地许多年轻人都受到嘻哈文化的影响。

examples.sentence: Numerous hip-hop artists have emerged in the last decade.
examples.translation_zh: 在过去的十年里，许多嘻哈艺术家涌现出来。

examples.sentence: Students often learn hip-hop dance in performing arts classes.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们通常在表演艺术课程中学习嘻哈舞蹈。

honeycomb.def_en: A structure made of hexagonal cells built by bees.

examples.sentence: Researchers studied the honeycomb structure for its efficiency.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员研究了蜂巢结构的高效性。

examples.sentence: Artists often create designs based on honeycomb patterns in their work.
examples.translation_zh: 艺术家们常在作品中创造基于蜂巢图案的设计。

examples.sentence: Children love to eat honeycomb pieces during breakfast.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们喜欢在早餐时吃蜂巢块。

honk.def_en: A short, loud sound made by a car horn.

examples.sentence: Cars honk their horns loudly during rush hour traffic.
examples.translation_zh: 高峰时段，汽车的鸣笛声响亮。

examples.sentence: He honked in frustration when the meeting was delayed.
examples.translation_zh: 会议延迟时，他感到沮丧而鸣笛。

examples.sentence: Drivers often honk at pedestrians to signal their presence.
examples.translation_zh: 司机常常对行人鸣笛以示提醒。

housekeeper.def_en: A person employed to manage a household.

examples.sentence: She performed her housekeeper duties with great attention to detail.
examples.translation_zh: 她对自己的管家职责非常注重细节。

examples.sentence: The housekeeper often prepares meals and cleans the living areas.
examples.translation_zh: 管家经常准备餐食并清理居住区域。

examples.sentence: Many hotels offer housekeeper services to enhance guest experiences.
examples.translation_zh: 许多酒店提供管家服务以提升客人的体验。

hot and sour soup.def_en: A spicy and sour soup commonly found in Chinese cuisine.

examples.sentence: I want to order hot and sour soup for dinner tonight.
examples.translation_zh: 我想今晚点酸辣汤作为晚餐。

examples.sentence: Many families make hot and sour soup for special occasions.
examples.translation_zh: 许多家庭在特殊场合制作酸辣汤。

examples.sentence: You can enjoy hot and sour soup when you have a cold.
examples.translation_zh: 生病时可以享用酸辣汤。

hurtful.def_en: Causing emotional pain or distress to someone.

examples.sentence: Many hurtful comments were made during the argument.
examples.translation_zh: 在争论中说了很多伤人的话。

examples.sentence: Such hurtful behavior can affect students' mental health.
examples.translation_zh: 这种伤人的行为会影响学生的心理健康。

examples.sentence: The politician's hurtful remarks drew widespread criticism.
examples.translation_zh: 这位政治家的伤人言论引发了广泛的批评。

ice hockey.def_en: A team sport played on ice where players hit a puck.

examples.sentence: Children often play ice hockey at the local rink.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们常常在当地的滑冰场打冰球。

examples.sentence: My brother joined an ice hockey team last year.
examples.translation_zh: 我哥哥去年加入了一支冰球队。

examples.sentence: Many fans watch ice hockey games on television.
examples.translation_zh: 许多球迷在电视上观看冰球比赛。

homesickness.def_en: A deep feeling of longing for one's home.

examples.sentence: Experiencing homesickness can be overwhelming for new students in college.
examples.translation_zh: 对于大学的新生来说，思乡之情可能会让人感到难以承受。

examples.sentence: Many people find ways to cure homesickness by staying connected with family.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人通过与家人保持联系来缓解思乡之情。

examples.sentence: Students often learn to overcome homesickness through engagement in campus activities.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们通常通过参与校园活动来克服思乡之情。

ice-skating.def_en: A sport of gliding on ice using skates.

examples.sentence: Many families go ice-skating during the winter holidays.
examples.translation_zh: 许多家庭在寒假期间去滑冰。

examples.sentence: This city has a beautiful ice-skating rink in the park.
examples.translation_zh: 这座城市公园里有一个美丽的滑冰场。

examples.sentence: Children can learn ice-skating at special classes offered weekly.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们可以在每周提供的特别课程中学习滑冰。

ice-skate.def_en: To move on ice using skates with blades on the bottom.

examples.sentence: We often ice-skate outdoors during the winter months.
examples.translation_zh: 我们在冬天的几个月里常常在户外滑冰。

examples.sentence: She practices regularly to ice-skate well for her competition.
examples.translation_zh: 为了比赛，她定期练习以便滑冰滑得好。

examples.sentence: Many people love to ice-skate with friends at the rink.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人喜欢在溜冰场和朋友一起滑冰。

ice cream.def_en: A sweet frozen dessert made from cream and sugar.

examples.sentence: Children love to eat ice cream in summer.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们喜欢在夏天吃冰淇淋。

examples.sentence: We visited an ice cream shop during our vacation.
examples.translation_zh: 我们在假期期间参观了一家冰淇淋店。

examples.sentence: She learned how to make ice cream at her job.
examples.translation_zh: 她在工作中学会了如何制作冰淇淋。

hopefully.def_en: In a way that expresses desire for a positive outcome.

examples.collocation: hopefully it will be sunny tomorrow
examples.sentence: Hopefully it will be sunny tomorrow for our picnic.
examples.translation_zh: 希望明天阳光明媚，适合我们去野餐。

examples.collocation: hopefully they will accept our proposal
examples.sentence: We submitted our project, and hopefully they will accept our proposal soon.
examples.translation_zh: 我们提交了项目，希望他们能尽快接受我们的提案。

examples.collocation: hopefully the research will yield results
examples.sentence: Researchers are optimistic, and hopefully the research will yield results this year.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员很有信心，希望今年的研究能取得成果。

iguana.def_en: A large lizard native to Central and South America.

examples.sentence: Green iguanas can often be found basking in the sun.
examples.translation_zh: 绿鬣蜥常常能在阳光下晒太阳。

examples.sentence: Researchers study iguana habitats to understand their ecological roles.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员研究鬣蜥栖息地以了解它们的生态作用。

examples.sentence: An iguana's diet mainly consists of leafy greens and fruits.
examples.translation_zh: 鬣蜥的饮食主要由绿叶蔬菜和水果组成。

iconic.def_en: Representing something of great significance or importance.

examples.sentence: Many films have an iconic scene that defines their genre.
examples.translation_zh: 许多电影都有一个标志性的场景，定义了它们的类型。

examples.sentence: She is considered an iconic figure in modern literature.
examples.translation_zh: 她被认为是现代文学中的标志性人物。

examples.sentence: The Eiffel Tower is an iconic symbol of Paris and its culture.
examples.translation_zh: 埃菲尔铁塔是巴黎及其文化的标志性象征。

imaging.def_en: The process of creating visual representations of objects or systems.

examples.sentence: Doctors often rely on medical imaging to diagnose various health conditions.
examples.translation_zh: 医生通常依赖医学成像来诊断各种健康状况。

examples.sentence: Advancements in imaging technology have improved our understanding of the universe.
examples.translation_zh: 成像技术的进步提高了我们对宇宙的理解。

examples.sentence: Students learn about various imaging techniques during their studies in physics.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们在物理学习中了解各种成像技术。

illegally.def_en: In a manner not permitted by law or rules.

examples.sentence: Researchers discovered that the data was illegally obtained in several cases.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员发现，数据在多个案例中是非法获取的。

examples.sentence: Someone reported an illegally parked car blocking the driveway.
examples.translation_zh: 有人报告了一辆非法停车的汽车阻塞了车道。

examples.sentence: Companies are facing fines for illegally dumping waste into the river.
examples.translation_zh: 公司因非法向河流倾倒废物而面临罚款。

immoral.def_en: Not conforming to accepted standards of morality.

examples.sentence: Many people find cheating to be an immoral behavior that harms relationships.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人认为作弊是不道德的行为，伤害了人际关系。

examples.sentence: Scholars often debate the implications of immoral actions in society.
examples.translation_zh: 学者们经常争论不道德行为对社会的影响。

examples.sentence: Recent investigations revealed several immoral practices in the financial sector.
examples.translation_zh: 最近的调查揭示了金融行业中的几种不道德的做法。

in addition.def_en: Also; used to introduce an additional point or idea.

examples.sentence: Students should focus on their hobbies in addition to their studies.
examples.translation_zh: 学生除了学习外，还应该关注自己的兴趣爱好。

examples.sentence: The report stated several problems, and in addition to that, proposed solutions.
examples.translation_zh: 报告列出了几个问题，此外还提出了解决方案。

examples.collocation: in addition to the main course
examples.sentence: You can order dessert in addition to the main course if you want.
examples.translation_zh: 如果你想的话，可以点主菜之外的甜点。

in case.def_en: To prepare for a possible future event or situation.

examples.sentence: You should always have a plan in case of emergency.
examples.translation_zh: 在紧急情况下，你应该总是有一个计划。

examples.sentence: I will send you the report in case you need it.
examples.translation_zh: 如果你需要，我会把报告发给你。

examples.sentence: We have a backup system in case something goes wrong with the server.
examples.translation_zh: 如果服务器出故障，我们有一个备份系统。

in a hurry.def_en: To act quickly or with speed due to time pressure.

examples.collocation: in a hurry to finish my homework
examples.sentence: I am in a hurry to finish my homework before dinner.
examples.translation_zh: 我急于在晚饭前完成作业。

examples.collocation: in a hurry for the meeting
examples.sentence: She is in a hurry for the meeting to start on time.
examples.translation_zh: 她急于让会议准时开始。

examples.collocation: in a hurry to catch the bus
examples.sentence: They were in a hurry to catch the bus to the airport.
examples.translation_zh: 他们急于赶上去机场的公交车。

in a row.def_en: To be situated one after another without interruption.

examples.sentence: I worked three days in a row without a break.
examples.translation_zh: 我连续工作了三天，没有休息。

examples.sentence: The team celebrated their three wins in a row last week.
examples.translation_zh: 球队上周庆祝他们连续三场胜利。

examples.sentence: She scheduled two meetings in a row to save time.
examples.translation_zh: 她安排了两场连续的会议，以节省时间。

impolite.def_en: Rude or lacking in good manners.

examples.sentence: People often make impolite remarks without realizing it.
examples.translation_zh: 人们常常在没有意识到的情况下说出不礼貌的言辞。

examples.sentence: Such impolite behavior can affect team dynamics negatively.
examples.translation_zh: 这种不礼貌的行为会对团队氛围产生负面影响。

examples.sentence: Students should avoid asking impolite questions during class discussions.
examples.translation_zh: 学生在课堂讨论中应避免提出不礼貌的问题。

importantly.def_en: In a way that is of great significance or importance.

examples.collocation: importantly, the study shows significant results
examples.sentence: The researchers found that, importantly, the study shows significant results.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员发现，重要的是，这项研究显示了显著的结果。

examples.collocation: This is importantly relevant to our discussion
examples.sentence: Now, this is importantly relevant to our discussion about the project.
examples.translation_zh: 现在，这与我们关于这个项目的讨论非常相关。

examples.collocation: Importantly, we need to consider the costs involved
examples.sentence: During the meeting, importantly, we need to consider the costs involved in the decision.
examples.translation_zh: 在会议上，重要的是，我们需要考虑决策中涉及的成本。

in contrast to.def_en: To show the differences between two or more things.

examples.sentence: Researchers found results in contrast to previous studies conducted.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员发现的结果与以往的研究形成对比。

examples.sentence: The economy is growing in contrast to other countries facing recession.
examples.translation_zh: 经济在与其他面临衰退的国家形成对比时仍在增长。

examples.sentence: Many facts exist in contrast to popular belief about the artist.
examples.translation_zh: 关于这位艺术家的许多事实与流行观念形成对比。

in class.def_en: To be present in a learning environment with others.

examples.sentence: Students often attend lectures in class to learn new topics.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们经常在课堂上参加讲座以学习新课题。

examples.sentence: Teachers encourage students to participate in class discussions for better understanding.
examples.translation_zh: 老师鼓励学生在课堂讨论中参与以便更好理解。

examples.sentence: Many professionals take notes in class to keep track of important information.
examples.translation_zh: 许多职场人士在课堂上做笔记以跟踪重要信息。

in fact.def_en: Used to emphasize a statement that is true.

examples.collocation: in fact, many people enjoy reading
examples.sentence: Many students enjoy reading books; in fact, it helps them learn.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生喜欢看书，事实上，这有助于他们学习。

examples.collocation: in fact, the results show improvement
examples.sentence: The data shows changes; in fact, the results show improvement.
examples.translation_zh: 数据表明有变化，事实上，结果显示出改善。

examples.collocation: in fact, experts believe it is important
examples.sentence: Teachers say reading is vital; in fact, experts believe it is important.
examples.translation_zh: 老师说阅读至关重要，事实上，专家认为这是重要的。

in future.def_en: Referring to a time period that is yet to come.

examples.sentence: People will look back at us in future generations.
examples.translation_zh: 人们会在未来的世代回顾我们。

examples.sentence: The project aims to reduce pollution in future years.
examples.translation_zh: 该项目旨在在未来几年内减少污染。

examples.sentence: We should include this idea in future plans.
examples.translation_zh: 我们应该在未来的计划中包含这个想法。

in general.def_en: Used to refer to a general condition or overall idea.

examples.sentence: In general terms, the findings are quite significant.
examples.translation_zh: 一般来说，这些发现相当重要。

examples.sentence: The team is in general agreement about the project's goals.
examples.translation_zh: 团队在项目目标上基本一致。

examples.sentence: These tools are in general use in many households.
examples.translation_zh: 这些工具在许多家庭中通常使用。

in line with.def_en: To be in agreement or harmony with something.

examples.sentence: Our decisions are in line with company policy.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的决定符合公司政策。

examples.collocation: in line with the latest research
examples.sentence: The findings are in line with the latest research.
examples.translation_zh: 这些发现与最新的研究一致。

examples.sentence: You must operate in line with local laws.
examples.translation_zh: 你必须遵循当地法律。

in high spirits.def_en: Feeling cheerful and happy; in a good mood.

examples.sentence: She is in high spirits after winning the game.
examples.translation_zh: 她在赢得比赛后心情愉快。

examples.sentence: They remained in high spirits despite the challenges.
examples.translation_zh: 尽管面临挑战，他们依然心情愉快。

examples.sentence: The community got in high spirits during the festival.
examples.translation_zh: 节日期间，社区的气氛非常愉快。

in need.def_en: To require assistance or support in some way.

examples.sentence: Many people in need live in our city.
examples.translation_zh: 我们城市里有很多需要帮助的人。

examples.sentence: We should help those in need during disasters.
examples.translation_zh: 在灾难期间，我们应该帮助那些需要帮助的人。

examples.sentence: Schools often support families in need with food.
examples.translation_zh: 学校常常为需要帮助的家庭提供食物。

in low spirits.def_en: Feeling sad or unhappy for a period of time.

examples.sentence: She is in low spirits today because of the weather.
examples.translation_zh: 今天天气不好，她情绪低落。

examples.sentence: Many people are feeling in low spirits during winter months.
examples.translation_zh: 冬天很多人情绪低落。

examples.sentence: He was in low spirits at work after receiving the news.
examples.translation_zh: 收到消息后，他在工作中情绪低落。

in order to.def_en: To do something with a specific purpose or aim.

examples.collocation: study hard in order to pass the exam.
examples.sentence: Students need to study hard in order to pass the exam.
examples.translation_zh: 学生需要努力学习，以便通过考试。

examples.collocation: save money in order to buy a car.
examples.sentence: She saves money in order to buy a car soon.
examples.translation_zh: 她存钱，以便尽快买车。

examples.collocation: exercise regularly in order to stay healthy.
examples.sentence: We should exercise regularly in order to stay healthy.
examples.translation_zh: 我们应该定期锻炼，以便保持健康。

in person.def_en: To meet someone directly and not through others.

examples.sentence: I want to meet in person this weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 我想这个周末亲自见面。

examples.sentence: She wants to speak to him in person about the project.
examples.translation_zh: 她想亲自和他谈谈这个项目。

examples.sentence: They prefer to interview students in person for better evaluation.
examples.translation_zh: 他们更喜欢亲自面试学生，以便更好地评估。

in other words.def_en: To express the same idea in a different way.

examples.collocation: in other words, your performance needs improvement
examples.sentence: Your results are below average; in other words, your performance needs improvement.
examples.translation_zh: 你的成绩低于平均水平，换句话说，你的表现需要改进。

examples.collocation: in other words, we need to act now
examples.sentence: The situation is critical; in other words, we need to act now.
examples.translation_zh: 形势紧急，换句话说，我们需要立即行动。

examples.collocation: in other words, it's not going to be easy
examples.sentence: This project is challenging; in other words, it's not going to be easy.
examples.translation_zh: 这个项目具有挑战性，换句话说，这并不容易。

in front of.def_en: To be located ahead of something else.

examples.collocation: stand in front of the mirror
examples.sentence: I like to stand in front of the mirror every morning.
examples.translation_zh: 我喜欢每天早上站在镜子前面。

examples.collocation: sit in front of the computer
examples.sentence: He often sits in front of the computer at his desk.
examples.translation_zh: 他经常坐在桌子前面的电脑前。

examples.collocation: wait in front of the store
examples.sentence: We will wait in front of the store for our friends.
examples.translation_zh: 我们将在商店前面等我们的朋友。

in public.def_en: To be in a place where anyone can see.

examples.sentence: He is afraid to talk in public during meetings.
examples.translation_zh: 他害怕在会议中公开发言。

examples.sentence: She loves to perform in public at local events.
examples.translation_zh: 她喜欢在当地活动中公开表演。

examples.sentence: Students will present their projects in public next week.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们将在下周公开展示他们的项目。

in return.def_en: To give something back in exchange for a favor.

examples.sentence: I will say thank you in return for your help.
examples.translation_zh: 我会为了你的帮助而说谢谢。

examples.sentence: They offered help in return for my support.
examples.translation_zh: 他们为了我的支持而提供帮助。

examples.sentence: A favor done in return can strengthen friendships.
examples.translation_zh: 作为回报的帮助可以增强友谊。

in spite of.def_en: Despite the fact that something happens or is true.

examples.sentence: Our team succeeded in spite of the challenges we faced.
examples.translation_zh: 尽管面临挑战，我们的团队仍然取得了成功。

examples.sentence: They decided to go hiking in spite of the weather forecast.
examples.translation_zh: 尽管天气预报不佳，他们还是决定去远足。

examples.sentence: She continued her art project in spite of criticism from others.
examples.translation_zh: 尽管受到他人的批评，她仍然继续她的艺术项目。

in particular.def_en: To indicate a particular focus or emphasis on something specific.

examples.sentence: Researchers found, in particular, the results to be surprising.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员发现，结果尤其令人惊讶。

examples.sentence: Many people love animals, in particular children enjoy pets.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人喜欢动物，特别是孩子们喜欢宠物。

examples.sentence: We need to address, in particular, that aspect of the project.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要特别关注项目的那个方面。

in that case.def_en: Used to indicate the consequence of a previous statement.

examples.collocation: in that case, we should leave early
examples.sentence: If it rains, in that case, we will stay home.
examples.translation_zh: 如果下雨， 在这种情况下，我们就待在家里。

examples.collocation: in that case, you can ask her
examples.sentence: I cannot help you, in that case, ask someone else.
examples.translation_zh: 我帮不了你， 在这种情况下，问其他人吧。

examples.collocation: in that case, they will agree
examples.sentence: The researchers found errors, in that case, they must revise.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员发现了错误， 在这种情况下，他们必须修订。

in time.def_en: At the correct or expected time, not late.

examples.sentence: We arrived in time for the movie to start.
examples.translation_zh: 我们及时到达，电影开始了。

examples.sentence: He must finish his work in time for the deadline.
examples.translation_zh: 他必须及时完成他的工作，以便于截止日期。

examples.sentence: She tries to arrive in time for her appointments.
examples.translation_zh: 她努力准时到达约会。

in the future.def_en: Referring to a time period that is yet to come.

examples.sentence: We will plan in the future for our new project.
examples.translation_zh: 我们将来会为我们的新项目进行计划。

examples.sentence: Many people want to invest in the future of technology.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人想要投资未来的科技。

examples.sentence: Students should think about their careers in the future.
examples.translation_zh: 学生应该考虑将来的职业。

in the form of.def_en: To exist or appear as something specific.

examples.collocation: in the form of a report
examples.sentence: The manager presented the findings in the form of a report.
examples.translation_zh: 经理以报告的形式展示了调查结果。

examples.sentence: They offered help in the form of assistance with moving.
examples.translation_zh: 他们以协助搬家的形式提供了帮助。

examples.sentence: Researchers found the data in the form of evidence supporting their theory.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员发现数据以支持其理论的证据形式存在。

in the middle.def_en: Located at an equal distance from the sides or ends.

examples.sentence: We should try to meet in the middle and agree.
examples.translation_zh: 我们应该努力在中间达成一致。

examples.collocation: in the middle of the road
examples.sentence: A car stopped suddenly in the middle of the road.
examples.translation_zh: 一辆车突然停在了马路中间。

examples.sentence: I feel stuck in the middle of this group project.
examples.translation_zh: 我觉得在这个小组项目中处于中间。

in the end.def_en: At the final point or conclusion of something.

examples.collocation: in the end, we decided to stay home
examples.sentence: We discussed it, and in the end, we stayed home.
examples.translation_zh: 我们讨论后，最后选择了留在家里。

examples.collocation: in the end, the project was successful
examples.sentence: They faced challenges, but in the end, the project succeeded.
examples.translation_zh: 他们遇到了挑战，但最终项目成功了。

examples.collocation: in the end, he won the award
examples.sentence: After much effort, he finally succeeded in the end.
examples.translation_zh: 经过努力，他最终获得了奖项。

in total.def_en: The total amount or number of something after adding.

examples.collocation: in total six participants attended the seminar
examples.sentence: Six participants attended the seminar in total.
examples.translation_zh: 总共六名参与者参加了研讨会。

examples.sentence: Three countries voted in total during the conference.
examples.translation_zh: 在会议上，总共三国投了票。

examples.collocation: in total five books were read
examples.sentence: Five books were read in total this month.
examples.translation_zh: 这个月总共读了五本书。

in vain.def_en: Without success or a desired result.

examples.sentence: Many people worked in vain efforts to solve the issue.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人徒劳无功地努力解决这个问题。

examples.sentence: She waited in vain hopes that he would return soon.
examples.translation_zh: 她徒然希望他能很快回来，等待着。

examples.sentence: Students often study in vain attempts to pass difficult exams.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们常常徒劳地学习，希望通过难度大的考试。

inaction.def_en: Failure to act or take decisions when necessary.

examples.sentence: Inactivity and inaction can hinder personal development and growth.
examples.translation_zh: 不作为和无所事事会阻碍个人的发展与成长。

examples.sentence: Many problems arise from inaction in the workplace during critical situations.
examples.translation_zh: 在关键时刻，工作场所的不作为会导致许多问题。

examples.sentence: Social inaction often leads to widespread discontent among community members.
examples.translation_zh: 社会的不作为常常导致社区成员之间的广泛不满。

independently.def_en: Without reliance on others; in a self-sufficient manner.

examples.sentence: Many employees prefer to work independently on their tasks.
examples.translation_zh: 许多员工更喜欢独立完成他们的任务。

examples.sentence: Students can study independently using various online resources available.
examples.translation_zh: 学生可以利用各种在线资源独立学习。

examples.sentence: As adults, they aim to live independently from their parents.
examples.translation_zh: 成年后，他们希望独立生活，不依赖父母。

indian.def_en: Relating to India or its people.

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy indian cuisine for its rich flavors.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人因其丰富的风味而喜欢印度菜。

examples.sentence: Exploring indian culture can be a fascinating experience for travelers.
examples.translation_zh: 探索印度文化对旅行者来说可能是一次迷人的经历。

examples.sentence: Students study indian history to understand its impact on the world.
examples.translation_zh: 学生学习印度历史以理解其对世界的影响。

inequality.def_en: The condition of being unequal in status, rights, or opportunities.

examples.sentence: Income inequality continues to rise in many countries around the world.
examples.translation_zh: 全球许多国家的收入不平等持续上升。

examples.sentence: Many researchers study the effects of social inequality on individuals' lives.
examples.translation_zh: 许多研究者研究社会不平等对个人生活的影响。

examples.sentence: Gender inequality remains a significant issue in many workplaces today.
examples.translation_zh: 性别不平等在许多职场仍然是一个重要问题。

including.def_en: Comprising or containing as part of a whole.

examples.sentence: Researchers are studying ecosystems, including various species of plants and animals.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员正在研究生态系统，包括各种植物和动物物种。

examples.sentence: The report covers all relevant information, including the latest updates on the case.
examples.translation_zh: 该报告涵盖了所有相关信息，包括案件的最新进展。

examples.sentence: I plan to invite everyone to the party, including my friends from college.
examples.translation_zh: 我计划邀请所有人参加聚会，包括我大学的朋友。

injured.def_en: Harmed or damaged physically or emotionally in an incident.

examples.sentence: Many injured workers are seeking compensation for their medical expenses.
examples.translation_zh: 许多受伤的工人正在寻求医疗费用的赔偿。

examples.sentence: Rescue organizations often help injured animals in distress.
examples.translation_zh: 救援组织通常帮助处于困境中的受伤动物。

examples.sentence: Several people were seriously injured in the car accident yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 昨天的车祸中，有几人受了重伤。

incredibly.def_en: Extremely impressive or difficult to believe; astonishing.

examples.sentence: Students often find incredibly talented teachers inspiring and motivating.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们常常觉得极其有才华的老师既鼓舞人心又令人激励。

examples.sentence: This new computer processes information incredibly fast compared to older models.
examples.translation_zh: 这台新电脑处理信息的速度比旧型号极其快速。

examples.sentence: Completing this project on time will be incredibly difficult given the circumstances.
examples.translation_zh: 考虑到情况，按时完成这个项目将极其困难。

inspirational.def_en: Providing motivation or encouragement to achieve something.

examples.sentence: Many people find strength in inspirational quotes during tough times.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在艰难时刻从鼓舞人心的名言中获得力量。

examples.sentence: Successful teams often have inspirational leaders who motivate their members.
examples.translation_zh: 成功的团队通常拥有鼓舞人心的领袖，他们激励成员。

examples.sentence: Teachers share inspirational stories to engage students and foster learning.
examples.translation_zh: 教师分享鼓舞人心的故事，以吸引学生并促进学习。

instead of.def_en: To choose one thing over another.

examples.sentence: I prefer staying home instead of going out with friends.
examples.translation_zh: 我更喜欢在家，而不是和朋友出去。

examples.sentence: We should try using paper instead of using plastic bags.
examples.translation_zh: 我们应该尝试使用纸袋，而不是使用塑料袋。

examples.sentence: She plays games instead of studying for her exam.
examples.translation_zh: 她玩游戏，而不是为考试学习。

interested.def_en: Having a curiosity or concern about something.

examples.sentence: Many people are interested in art from different cultures.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人对不同文化的艺术感兴趣。

examples.sentence: The interested parties met to discuss the proposed changes.
examples.translation_zh: 相关方会面讨论提议的变更。

examples.sentence: Several interested students signed up for the photography class.
examples.translation_zh: 几位感兴趣的学生报名参加了摄影课程。

instantaneously.def_en: In a very short time; immediately or at once.

examples.sentence: Devices can respond instantaneously to changes in their environment.
examples.translation_zh: 设备可以瞬间对环境变化作出反应。

examples.sentence: The weather conditions can change instantaneously in this region.
examples.translation_zh: 该地区的天气状况可能瞬间变化。

examples.sentence: Some phenomena in quantum physics can occur instantaneously and without delay.
examples.translation_zh: 量子物理中某些现象可以瞬间发生，且没有延迟。

intently.def_en: With great focus or concentration; paying close attention.

examples.sentence: Children often listen intently when their grandparents share stories.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们常常专注地听祖父母讲故事。

examples.sentence: He gazed intently at the artwork, completely absorbed in its details.
examples.translation_zh: 他专注地凝视着艺术品，完全沉浸在细节中。

examples.sentence: Students study intently during exam preparation to achieve good results.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们在备考期间专注地学习，以取得好成绩。

italian.def_en: Relating to Italy or its people, culture, or language.

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy italian cuisine for its rich flavors.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人喜欢意大利菜，因为它的味道丰富。

examples.sentence: Students often learn the italian language for travel purposes.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们通常为了旅行而学习意大利语。

examples.sentence: Famous works of italian art can be found in museums worldwide.
examples.translation_zh: 世界各地的博物馆里都有著名的意大利艺术作品。

in the sun.def_en: To be exposed to sunlight or bright sunlight.

examples.sentence: Children love to play in the sun during summer.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们喜欢在夏天的阳光下玩耍。

examples.sentence: We decided to sit in the sun on the beach.
examples.translation_zh: 我们决定在海滩上坐在阳光下。

examples.sentence: Farmers often work in the sun all day long.
examples.translation_zh: 农民们常常整天在阳光下工作。

iranian.def_en: Relating to Iran or its people.

examples.sentence: Iranian culture is rich in history and traditions.
examples.translation_zh: 伊朗文化丰富多彩，历史悠久。

examples.sentence: The Iranian government recently announced new policies for trade.
examples.translation_zh: 伊朗政府最近宣布了新的贸易政策。

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy the flavors of Iranian cuisine at restaurants.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在餐厅享受伊朗美食的风味。

interested in.def_en: To want to know or learn about something.

examples.sentence: Many students are interested in science topics this semester.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生这个学期对科学课题感兴趣。

examples.sentence: She is very interested in art and history museums.
examples.translation_zh: 她非常对艺术和历史博物馆感兴趣。

examples.sentence: They are interested in travel and exploring new cultures.
examples.translation_zh: 他们对旅行和探索新文化感兴趣。

jump rope.def_en: To skip while turning a rope over one's head and under the feet.

examples.sentence: Children often play jump rope during recess.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们在课间常常跳绳。

examples.sentence: I want to learn to jump rope this summer.
examples.translation_zh: 我想在这个夏天学会跳绳。

examples.sentence: They practice jump rope for exercise every morning.
examples.translation_zh: 他们每天早晨跳绳锻炼。

ivy.def_en: A climbing plant with small, lobed leaves.

examples.sentence: The Ivy League schools are renowned for their academic excellence.
examples.translation_zh: 常春藤盟校因其学术卓越而闻名。

examples.sentence: Exposure to poison ivy can cause severe skin irritation.
examples.translation_zh: 接触毒常春藤可能导致严重的皮肤刺激。

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy growing ivy plants in their gardens.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人喜欢在花园里种植常春藤植物。

jawline.def_en: The outline or shape of the lower jaw.

examples.sentence: Many people consider a strong jawline to be attractive features.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人认为有力的下颌线是迷人的特征。

examples.sentence: Experts often define jawline characteristics when studying facial aesthetics.
examples.translation_zh: 专家在研究面部美学时常常定义下颌线特征。

examples.sentence: The jawline structure can influence overall facial symmetry and balance.
examples.translation_zh: 下颌线结构会影响整体面部对称性和协调性。

keep off.def_en: To stay away from or avoid something.

examples.sentence: Please keep off the grass in the park.
examples.translation_zh: 请不要走在公园的草地上。

examples.sentence: Workers must keep off dangerous areas at all times.
examples.translation_zh: 工人必须始终不靠近危险区域。

examples.sentence: Drivers should keep off the road during the storm.
examples.translation_zh: 驾驶员在暴风雨期间应避免上路。

junior high.def_en: A school level between elementary and high school.

examples.sentence: Many students attend junior high school after elementary.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生在小学后上初中。

examples.sentence: Junior high students often face new challenges and friendships.
examples.translation_zh: 初中生常常面临新的挑战和友谊。

examples.sentence: The government is improving junior high education in rural areas.
examples.translation_zh: 政府正在改善乡村地区的初中教育。

jump the queue.def_en: To enter a line of people without waiting your turn.

examples.collocation: jump the queue at the cinema
examples.sentence: Some people will jump the queue at the cinema.
examples.translation_zh: 有些人会在电影院插队。

examples.collocation: jump the queue for the bus
examples.sentence: You should not jump the queue for the bus.
examples.translation_zh: 你不应该在公交车前插队。

examples.sentence: It is rude to jump the queue during lunch.
examples.translation_zh: 午餐时插队是不礼貌的。

kg.def_en: A unit of mass equal to one thousand grams.

examples.sentence: I need to buy 5 kg of flour for the recipe.
examples.translation_zh: 我需要买5千克面粉来做这个食谱。

examples.sentence: His weight is measured at 70 kg during the check-up.
examples.translation_zh: 在体检时，他的体重测量为70千克。

examples.sentence: There was a 2 kg increase in the sample's weight after the experiment.
examples.translation_zh: 实验后，样本的重量增加了2千克。

keyhole.def_en: A small opening that allows viewing or access.

examples.sentence: He was looking through a keyhole to see what was happening inside.
examples.translation_zh: 他正在钥匙孔处偷看里面发生了什么。

examples.sentence: Keyhole surgery is less invasive than traditional surgery techniques.
examples.translation_zh: 钥匙孔手术比传统手术技术侵入性小。

examples.sentence: The camera provided a keyhole view of the distant planet's surface.
examples.translation_zh: 这台相机提供了对遥远行星表面的钥匙孔视图。

kung fu.def_en: A Chinese martial art emphasizing physical skill and discipline.

examples.sentence: Many children practice kung fu regularly after school.
examples.translation_zh: 许多孩子放学后定期练习功夫。

examples.sentence: Students can learn kung fu in special classes.
examples.translation_zh: 学生可以在特殊课程中学习功夫。

examples.sentence: There is a new film about kung fu this summer.
examples.translation_zh: 这个夏天有一部关于功夫的新电影。

km.def_en: A unit of length equal to 1,000 meters.

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy participating in the annual 10 km race.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人喜欢参加每年的 10 公里比赛。

examples.sentence: The car can travel at a speed of 200 km per hour.
examples.translation_zh: 这辆车的速度可以达到每小时 200 公里。

examples.sentence: We need to measure the km distance to our destination.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要测量到目的地的公里距离。

korea.def_en: A country in East Asia, known for its rich culture.

examples.sentence: South Korea has made significant advancements in technology recently.
examples.translation_zh: 韩国最近在科技方面取得了重大进展。

examples.sentence: Traveling to North Korea offers a unique glimpse into its history.
examples.translation_zh: 去朝鲜旅行可以独特地了解其历史。

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy Korean food for its delicious flavors and variety.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人喜欢韩国菜，因为它的美味和多样性。

large-scale.def_en: Involving extensive or significant scope or size.

examples.sentence: Researchers conduct large-scale studies to gather more comprehensive data.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员进行大规模的研究以收集更全面的数据。

examples.sentence: The company is launching several large-scale projects this year.
examples.translation_zh: 公司今年将启动几个大规模的项目。

examples.sentence: Recent events have led to large-scale changes in public policy.
examples.translation_zh: 最近的事件导致了公共政策的大规模变化。

last name.def_en: The family name of a person.

examples.sentence: Can you please ask for your last name?
examples.translation_zh: 你能问一下你的姓吗？

examples.sentence: You can change your last name after marriage.
examples.translation_zh: 结婚后你可以更改你的姓氏。

examples.sentence: Students need to write down their last names on the paper.
examples.translation_zh: 学生需要在纸上写下他们的姓。

last but not least.def_en: To emphasize the importance of the final item mentioned.

examples.collocation: last but not least, our volunteers made this event possible
examples.sentence: Volunteers helped us with everything, last but not least, supporting the teams.
examples.translation_zh: 志愿者在各方面都帮助了我们，最后但同样重要的是，支持了各支队伍。

examples.collocation: last but not least, the findings are significant
examples.sentence: Researchers shared their results; last but not least, the findings are important.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员分享了他们的结果，最后但同样重要的是，这些发现是重要的。

examples.collocation: last but not least, education plays a vital role
examples.sentence: In our discussion, last but not least, education is crucial for everyone.
examples.translation_zh: 在我们的讨论中，最后但同样重要的是，教育对每个人都至关重要。

late for.def_en: To arrive after the expected or scheduled time.

examples.sentence: I was late for class because of the traffic.
examples.translation_zh: 因为交通，我上课迟到了。

examples.sentence: He hates being late for work every morning.
examples.translation_zh: 他讨厌每天早上上班迟到。

examples.sentence: They arrived late for dinner and missed the first course.
examples.translation_zh: 他们晚到了晚餐，错过了第一道菜。

laugh at.def_en: To make fun of someone or something in a disrespectful way.

examples.sentence: Children often laugh at funny cartoons on TV.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们常常嘲笑电视上的有趣动画片。

examples.sentence: Teachers should not laugh at students' mistakes in class.
examples.translation_zh: 老师不应该在课堂上嘲笑学生的错误。

examples.sentence: We all laugh at a joke during the meeting yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 我们昨天在会议上都笑了一个笑话。

knock around.def_en: To spend time in a casual or aimless way.

examples.sentence: We plan to knock around the city this weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 我们计划这个周末在城市里闲逛。

examples.sentence: She likes to knock around with friends after school.
examples.translation_zh: 放学后，她喜欢和朋友们闲逛。

examples.sentence: They often knock around the house on rainy days.
examples.translation_zh: 下雨天，他们经常在家闲逛。

lastly.def_en: In the end; finally, after all other points have been made.

examples.collocation: lastly, we must consider the financial aspects.
examples.sentence: We will discuss the project details and lastly, we must consider the financial aspects.
examples.translation_zh: 我们将讨论项目细节，最后我们必须考虑财务方面。

examples.collocation: lastly, the research supports our findings.
examples.sentence: The study is comprehensive, and lastly, the research supports our findings.
examples.translation_zh: 这项研究非常全面，最后研究支持我们的发现。

examples.sentence: Complete the form and lastly, please send your feedback.
examples.translation_zh: 填写完表格后，最后请发送您的反馈。

leave out.def_en: To not include someone or something.

examples.sentence: You should not leave out important details in the report.
examples.translation_zh: 你不应该在报告中省略重要细节。

examples.sentence: Teachers often leave out the instructions for the homework.
examples.translation_zh: 老师们常常省略作业的说明。

examples.sentence: Sometimes I leave out some words when I speak.
examples.translation_zh: 有时候我说话时会省略一些词。

leave a message.def_en: To send a written or recorded communication to someone.

examples.collocation: leave a message for the teacher
examples.sentence: You can leave a message for the teacher after class.
examples.translation_zh: 下课后你可以给老师留言。

examples.collocation: leave a message on the machine
examples.sentence: If I'm not home, please leave a message on the machine.
examples.translation_zh: 如果我不在家，请在电话机上留言。

examples.sentence: She asked me to leave a message at work for her.
examples.translation_zh: 她让我在工作时给她留言。

let off steam.def_en: To release pent-up energy or emotions.

examples.sentence: Many people let off steam after work by exercising.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人通过锻炼在下班后发泄情绪。

examples.sentence: Friends often let off steam together while chatting over coffee.
examples.translation_zh: 朋友们常常在喝咖啡时聊天发泄情绪。

examples.sentence: Some individuals let off steam through sports like running or swimming.
examples.translation_zh: 一些人通过跑步或游泳等运动来发泄情绪。

life-saving.def_en: Preventing loss of life or serious injury.

examples.sentence: Doctors often provide life-saving treatments in emergency situations.
examples.translation_zh: 医生常常在紧急情况下提供救命的治疗。

examples.sentence: Learning life-saving skills can help you in dangerous situations.
examples.translation_zh: 学习救命技能可以帮助你应对危险情况。

examples.sentence: New life-saving technologies are being developed every year.
examples.translation_zh: 每年都有新的救命技术被开发出来。

lifelike.def_en: Very realistic or resembling real life closely.

examples.sentence: Artists create lifelike figures that inspire awe and admiration.
examples.translation_zh: 艺术家创造栩栩如生的雕像，令人敬畏和钦佩。

examples.sentence: Researchers developed a lifelike environment to simulate real-world scenarios.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员开发了一个栩栩如生的环境来模拟真实场景。

examples.sentence: Students studied lifelike images to better understand historical events.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们研究栩栩如生的图像，以更好地理解历史事件。

knock down.def_en: To cause something or someone to fall or be destroyed.

examples.sentence: Workers will knock down the walls next week.
examples.translation_zh: 工人们下周将击倒这些墙。

examples.sentence: They plan to knock down a building in the city.
examples.translation_zh: 他们计划在城市里推倒一栋建筑。

examples.sentence: Stores often knock down prices during sales.
examples.translation_zh: 商店通常在促销期间降低价格。

laughing stock.def_en: A person or thing that is the subject of ridicule.

examples.sentence: He always makes a laughing stock of himself in meetings.
examples.translation_zh: 他在会议上总是让自己成为笑柄。

examples.sentence: The politician became a laughing stock after his latest mistake.
examples.translation_zh: 这位政治家在最近的失误后成为笑柄。

examples.sentence: She turned into a laughing stock when she tripped over her own feet.
examples.translation_zh: 她在自己绊倒时成了笑柄。

lifeline.def_en: A thing or person that provides support or assistance.

examples.sentence: Workers can use safety lifelines to prevent falls from heights.
examples.translation_zh: 工人可以使用安全生命线来防止高处坠落。

examples.sentence: Emergency lifelines are crucial during natural disasters and crises.
examples.translation_zh: 在自然灾害和危机期间，紧急生命线至关重要。

examples.sentence: Mentoring programs serve as lifelines for students facing challenges.
examples.translation_zh: 辅导项目为面临挑战的学生提供生命线。

let down.def_en: To disappoint someone or fail to meet their expectations.

examples.sentence: You really let down the team by not showing up.
examples.translation_zh: 你真的让队伍失望了，因为没有到场。

examples.sentence: It's not nice to let down your friends when they need help.
examples.translation_zh: 在朋友需要帮助的时候让他们失望是不好的。

examples.sentence: The news may let down their hopes for a better future.
examples.translation_zh: 这个消息可能让他们对美好未来的希望失望。

lightning rod.def_en: A device to protect structures from lightning strikes.

examples.sentence: Workers will install a lightning rod on the roof today.
examples.translation_zh: 工人们今天将在屋顶安装避雷针。

examples.sentence: The politician became a lightning rod for criticism after the scandal.
examples.translation_zh: 这位政治家在丑闻后成为批评的焦点。

examples.sentence: Engineers use lightning rods for safety in tall buildings.
examples.translation_zh: 工程师在高楼中使用避雷针以确保安全。

lifelong.def_en: Lasting for the duration of a person's life.

examples.sentence: Many adults engage in lifelong learning to improve their skills.
examples.translation_zh: 许多成年人参与终身学习以提升技能。

examples.sentence: She made lifelong friends during her college years.
examples.translation_zh: 她在大学时期结交了终身朋友。

examples.sentence: A lifelong commitment to excellence is essential for success.
examples.translation_zh: 对卓越的终身承诺是成功的关键。

linguist.def_en: A person skilled in multiple languages or linguistics.

examples.sentence: Many companies hire a professional linguist for translation projects.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司聘请专业的语言学家进行翻译项目。

examples.sentence: Trained linguists often contribute to language preservation efforts around the world.
examples.translation_zh: 受过培训的语言学家常常为全球语言保护工作做出贡献。

examples.sentence: Developing linguist skills can enhance communication in diverse settings.
examples.translation_zh: 培养语言学家的技能可以提升在多样环境中的沟通能力。

listen to.def_en: To pay attention to sounds or someone speaking.

examples.sentence: I love to listen to music while I study.
examples.translation_zh: 我喜欢在学习时听音乐。

examples.sentence: Many people listen to the news every morning.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人每天早上听新闻。

examples.sentence: Employees must listen to instructions carefully during training.
examples.translation_zh: 员工在培训时必须仔细听取指令。

lighting.def_en: The arrangement of lights in a space or area.

examples.sentence: Lighting design plays a crucial role in creating a mood for events.
examples.translation_zh: 照明设计在为活动营造氛围方面发挥着重要作用。

examples.sentence: Effective stage lighting enhances the performance and captivates the audience.
examples.translation_zh: 有效的舞台照明增强了表演，并吸引了观众。

examples.sentence: New lighting equipment has significantly improved energy efficiency in buildings.
examples.translation_zh: 新型照明设备显著提高了建筑物的能源效率。

lock up.def_en: To secure something so it cannot be opened or accessed.

examples.sentence: They always lock up the house before going out.
examples.translation_zh: 他们总是在外出前锁上房子。

examples.sentence: The police need to lock up the evidence carefully.
examples.translation_zh: 警方需要小心地锁上证据。

examples.sentence: Many businesses lock up at night to prevent theft.
examples.translation_zh: 许多商店晚上锁上以防盗窃。

logging.def_en: The process of cutting down trees for timber.

examples.sentence: Illegal logging causes significant harm to forests and biodiversity.
examples.translation_zh: 非法伐木对森林和生物多样性造成了重大伤害。

examples.sentence: The logging industry provides many jobs in rural areas around the world.
examples.translation_zh: 伐木行业为全球农村地区提供了许多就业机会。

examples.sentence: Scientists are logging data to study climate change effects on ecosystems.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家们正在记录数据，以研究气候变化对生态系统的影响。

logo.def_en: A symbol or design representing a company or brand.

examples.sentence: The company logo is displayed on all product packaging.
examples.translation_zh: 公司标志印在所有产品包装上。

examples.sentence: Many people recognize the brand logo without seeing the name.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在没有看到名称的情况下就能认出品牌标志。

examples.sentence: Students wear uniforms that feature the school logo.
examples.translation_zh: 学生穿着带有校徽的校服。

long ago.def_en: At a time in the past, not recent.

examples.sentence: Things were different when they happened long ago.
examples.translation_zh: 当事情发生在很久以前时，一切都不同了。

examples.sentence: The ancient city was built long ago and still stands today.
examples.translation_zh: 这座古老的城市建于很久以前，至今仍然屹立。

examples.sentence: Many species existed long ago before the dinosaurs appeared.
examples.translation_zh: 许多物种在恐龙出现之前就存在于很久以前。

long face.def_en: An expression showing sadness or disappointment.

examples.sentence: He always wears a long face when he is upset.
examples.translation_zh: 他不高兴的时候总是愁苦的面容。

examples.sentence: She puts on a long face whenever there is bad news.
examples.translation_zh: 每当有坏消息时，她就会愁苦的面容。

examples.sentence: Students often have a long face after receiving low grades.
examples.translation_zh: 学生在收到低分后通常会愁苦的面容。

living room.def_en: A room in a house for relaxing and socializing.

examples.sentence: She wants to furnish the living room with new furniture.
examples.translation_zh: 她想用新家具来布置客厅。

examples.collocation: spend time in the living room
examples.sentence: We often spend time in the living room with family and friends.
examples.translation_zh: 我们常常和家人朋友一起在客厅里度过时光。

examples.sentence: They plan to decorate the living room for the holidays.
examples.translation_zh: 他们计划为假期装饰客厅。

look at.def_en: To direct one's gaze toward something or someone.

examples.sentence: Children love to look at the pictures in books.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们喜欢看书中的图片。

examples.sentence: Students should look at the results carefully after the test.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们在考试后应仔细查看结果。

examples.sentence: Many people look at the news every morning.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人每天早上看新闻。

loneliness.def_en: The state of being alone or isolated without companionship.

examples.sentence: Many people struggle with overcoming loneliness during difficult times.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在困难时期与孤独作斗争。

examples.sentence: Feelings of loneliness can affect mental health and well-being.
examples.translation_zh: 孤独感会影响心理健康和幸福感。

examples.sentence: Experts warn that the loneliness epidemic is affecting our society increasingly.
examples.translation_zh: 专家警告称，孤独症的流行正日益影响我们的社会。

look back at.def_en: To think about something from the past.

examples.sentence: People often look back at their life and learn.
examples.translation_zh: 人们常常回顾自己的生活并从中学习。

examples.sentence: We should look back at history to understand our present.
examples.translation_zh: 我们应该回顾历史以理解我们的现在。

examples.sentence: Artists sometimes look back at the past for inspiration.
examples.translation_zh: 艺术家有时会回顾过去以寻找灵感。

look for.def_en: To search or seek something or someone.

examples.sentence: Many people look for a job after graduation.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在毕业后寻找工作。

examples.sentence: Children often look for help when they are confused.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们在困惑时常常寻求帮助。

examples.sentence: Students should look for answers to their questions in the textbook.
examples.translation_zh: 学生应该在教科书中寻找他们问题的答案。

look forward to.def_en: To feel excited about something that will happen.

examples.sentence: I look forward to the weekend every week.
examples.translation_zh: 我每周都期待周末。

examples.sentence: We look forward to seeing you at the meeting.
examples.translation_zh: 我们期待在会议上见到您。

examples.sentence: Children look forward to the holidays every year.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们每年都期待假期。

located.def_en: Situated in a particular place or position.

examples.sentence: Her office is located in the city center.
examples.translation_zh: 她的办公室位于市中心。

examples.sentence: The hotel is conveniently located near the beach.
examples.translation_zh: 这家酒店方便地位于海滩附近。

examples.sentence: This historical site is located on the map of our guide.
examples.translation_zh: 这个历史遗址在我们导游的地图上。

look up to.def_en: To admire or have great respect for someone.

examples.sentence: Students often look up to my teachers for guidance.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们常常尊敬我的老师，寻求指导。

examples.sentence: Children usually look up to their parents as role models.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们通常把父母视为榜样。

examples.sentence: Many people look up to famous leaders for inspiration.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人尊敬著名的领袖，以获得灵感。

lost.def_en: Not able to be found or no longer in possession of something.

examples.sentence: Many people feel they have lost time during the pandemic.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人觉得在疫情期间失去了时间。

examples.sentence: She regretted the lost opportunity for a promotion at work.
examples.translation_zh: 她后悔在工作中失去了晋升的机会。

examples.sentence: Students often seem lost in thought during challenging lectures.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们在困难的讲座中常常显得失神。

lose track of.def_zh: 失去对某事的跟踪；忘记某事的进展
lose track of.def_en: To fail to keep informed about someone or something.

examples.sentence: I often lose track of time when I read a good book.
examples.translation_zh: 我常常在读好书时忘记时间。

examples.sentence: He tends to lose track of details during busy meetings.
examples.translation_zh: 在忙碌的会议中，他容易忘记细节。

examples.sentence: Researchers can lose track of information over time if not documented.
examples.translation_zh: 如果不进行记录，研究人员可能会随时间忘记信息。

look after.def_en: To take care of a person, animal, or thing.

examples.sentence: Parents often look after their children after school.
examples.translation_zh: 父母们常常在放学后照顾他们的孩子。

examples.sentence: You should look after your pets by feeding them well.
examples.translation_zh: 你应该通过好好喂养来照顾你的宠物。

examples.sentence: We all need to look after the environment for future generations.
examples.translation_zh: 我们都需要照顾环境，为未来的世代。

lucky you.def_en: You are fortunate or have good luck.

examples.sentence: Everyone says lucky you for winning the lottery.
examples.translation_zh: 大家都说你真幸运，因为你中奖了。

examples.sentence: How does it feel being lucky you on vacation?
examples.translation_zh: 你度假真幸运，感觉如何？

examples.sentence: Lucky you got the promotion before the deadline.
examples.translation_zh: 你真幸运，在截止日期前晋升了。

lotus.def_en: A type of aquatic flower known for its beauty.

examples.sentence: Many people admire the lotus flower for its elegance and beauty.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人欣赏莲花的优雅与美丽。

examples.sentence: Researchers studied how lotus leaves repel dirt and water effectively.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员研究了莲叶如何有效地排斥污垢和水。

examples.sentence: Practicing yoga often includes sitting in the lotus position for meditation.
examples.translation_zh: 练习瑜伽时经常会以莲花坐的姿势进行冥想。

look into.def_en: To examine or investigate something closely.

examples.sentence: Journalists will look into the issue of climate change.
examples.translation_zh: 记者们将调查气候变化的问题。

examples.sentence: We need to look into the matter before making a decision.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要在做决定前调查此事。

examples.sentence: She plans to look into the situation with her neighbor.
examples.translation_zh: 她打算调查与邻居的情况。

lungfish.def_en: A type of freshwater fish with lung-like structures.

examples.sentence: Researchers discovered lungfish fossils dating back millions of years.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员发现了数百万年前的肺鱼化石。

examples.sentence: Some lungfish species can survive in extreme drought conditions.
examples.translation_zh: 一些肺鱼物种能够在极端干旱的条件下生存。

examples.sentence: The lungfish habitat includes shallow lakes and swamps in Africa.
examples.translation_zh: 肺鱼的栖息地包括非洲的浅湖和沼泽。

lyrics.def_en: Words of a song or musical composition.

examples.sentence: Many fans memorize their favorite song lyrics easily.
examples.translation_zh: 许多粉丝很容易记住他们最喜欢的歌词。

examples.sentence: She decided to write lyrics for her new album.
examples.translation_zh: 她决定为她的新专辑写歌词。

examples.sentence: Teachers can help students analyze lyrics for deeper meaning.
examples.translation_zh: 老师可以帮助学生分析歌词，寻找更深的含义。

loose lips sink ships.def_en: Careless talk can lead to serious consequences or dangers.

examples.collocation: loose lips sink ships during meetings
examples.sentence: She reminded everyone that loose lips sink ships during meetings.
examples.translation_zh: 她提醒大家，嘴巴松在会议中会导致麻烦。

examples.collocation: loose lips sink ships in politics
examples.sentence: Many journalists believe that loose lips sink ships in politics.
examples.translation_zh: 许多记者认为，嘴巴松在政治上会造成问题。

examples.collocation: loose lips sink ships when gossiping
examples.sentence: People sometimes forget that loose lips sink ships when gossiping.
examples.translation_zh: 人们有时忘记，嘴巴松在八卦时会引发麻烦。

made of.def_en: To be constructed or formed from a particular material.

examples.sentence: This table is made of wood and is very sturdy.
examples.translation_zh: 这张桌子是由木头制成的，十分结实。

examples.sentence: Many toys are made of plastic for durability.
examples.translation_zh: 许多玩具是由塑料制成的，以增加耐用性。

examples.sentence: The tools are made of metal to ensure strength.
examples.translation_zh: 这些工具是由金属制成的，以确保强度。

madly.def_en: In a very enthusiastic or uncontrolled manner.

examples.sentence: She is madly in love with her childhood friend.
examples.translation_zh: 她疯狂地爱着她的童年朋友。

examples.sentence: The team members were running madly to meet the deadline.
examples.translation_zh: 团队成员们疯狂地奔跑以赶上截止日期。

examples.sentence: Everyone was laughing madly during the comedy show.
examples.translation_zh: 在喜剧表演中，大家都疯狂地笑。

make a mess.def_en: To create a situation that is disorganized or messy.

examples.collocation: make a mess in the kitchen
examples.sentence: Kids always make a mess in the kitchen when baking.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们在厨房烘焙时总是制造混乱。

examples.collocation: make a mess during the project
examples.sentence: The team members made a mess during the project presentation.
examples.translation_zh: 团队成员在项目展示时制造了混乱。

examples.collocation: make a mess at the party
examples.sentence: Guests often make a mess at the party with food everywhere.
examples.translation_zh: 客人在派对上常常到处制造混乱，食物满地都是。

magnifier.def_en: A tool that makes objects appear larger.

examples.sentence: Many people use a magnifier for small text when reading.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人阅读时会使用放大镜来查看小字。

examples.sentence: An optical magnifier is essential for viewing tiny details.
examples.translation_zh: 光学放大镜对于观察微小细节是必不可少的。

examples.sentence: Students can use a magnifier glass to study small specimens.
examples.translation_zh: 学生可以使用放大镜来研究小标本。

make a promise.def_en: To commit to doing something in the future.

examples.sentence: I always make a promise to help my friends.
examples.translation_zh: 我总是许诺帮助我的朋友。

examples.sentence: You should make a promise to yourself to stay focused.
examples.translation_zh: 你应该许诺自己保持专注。

examples.sentence: Students often make a promise to keep studying hard.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们经常许诺努力学习。

make a mistake.def_en: To do something incorrectly or make an error.

examples.collocation: make a mistake on the test
examples.sentence: Students often make a mistake on the test.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们常常在考试中犯错误。

examples.sentence: You should not make a mistake at work today.
examples.translation_zh: 你今天不应该在工作中犯错误。

examples.collocation: make a mistake during the trip
examples.sentence: Travelers sometimes make a mistake during the trip.
examples.translation_zh: 旅行者在旅途中有时会犯错误。

make a difference.def_en: To cause a significant change or effect in a situation.

examples.sentence: Teachers can make a difference in students' lives every day.
examples.translation_zh: 老师每天都能对学生的生活产生影响。

examples.collocation: make a difference to the environment
examples.sentence: Small actions can make a difference to our planet's health.
examples.translation_zh: 小行动可以对我们地球的健康产生影响。

examples.collocation: make a difference in the community
examples.sentence: Volunteers always try to make a difference in their community.
examples.translation_zh: 志愿者总是努力在他们的社区中产生影响。

make every effort.def_en: To try one's hardest to achieve something.

examples.sentence: She will make every effort to succeed in her job.
examples.translation_zh: 她将尽全力在工作中取得成功。

examples.sentence: They made every effort to help their friends.
examples.translation_zh: 他们尽全力去帮助朋友。

examples.sentence: Students should make every effort to improve their grades.
examples.translation_zh: 学生应该尽全力提高自己的成绩。

make money.def_en: To earn money through work or investment.

examples.sentence: Many people make money online from home.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在家网上赚钱。

examples.sentence: It is hard to make money quickly in business.
examples.translation_zh: 在商业中，快速赚钱是很难的。

examples.sentence: Investors hope to make money from investments this year.
examples.translation_zh: 投资者希望今年能从投资中赚钱。

make friends.def_en: To form new friendships with others.

examples.sentence: Children often make friends at school very quickly.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们在学校经常很快交朋友。

examples.sentence: It is nice to make friends with neighbors in your area.
examples.translation_zh: 与附近的邻居交朋友很好。

examples.sentence: Many people make friends online through social media platforms.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人在社交媒体平台上交朋友。

make ends meet.def_en: To have enough money to cover basic living expenses.

examples.sentence: She tries hard to manage to make ends meet every month.
examples.translation_zh: 她每个月都努力使收支相抵。

examples.sentence: Many families struggle to make ends meet during tough times.
examples.translation_zh: 许多家庭在困难时期挣扎着使收支相抵。

examples.collocation: find ways to make ends meet
